headline: Senior housing, CLC kitchen, and parking passes are on the agenda, along with the Cultivating Connections Grant.
summary: The agenda also lists the Women's Expo 2027 and rebranding. Reports from the director and the Friends of the COA are also on the list.
location: Levesque Community Life Center Conference Room, 401 Bridge Street, Salem, MA

AGENDA 
SALEM COUNCIL ON AGING & SENIOR SERVICES 
REGULAR MONTHLY MEETING 
 
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. 
 
Notice is hereby given that the regular monthly meeting of the Salem Council on Aging & Senior 
Services Board will be held on Wednesday, NOVEMBER 18, 2026 at 5:15 p.m. in person at the 
Levesque Community Life Center Conference Room, 401 Bridge Street, Salem, MA. In person 
shall be the primary method of public access to this meeting. A secondary method of public access is 
provided as a courtesy, and if technologically feasible, through Zoom. 
 
Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting may 
access the remote participation meeting through any one of the following ways:
